author: user
text: One reconnect in forty is worse than it sounds — a session of any length hits it more often than not. What makes you confident this belongs in the first patch rather than holding the ship?

author: claude
text: Two things. Nothing is lost either way — the edits stay queued, so the worst of it is a reader watching a spinner until they background the app. And the workaround is written and tested: resending on a twenty-second timer turns the stall into a delay nobody watches. What would actually remove it is the vendor fix, and they have acknowledged it without naming a date, so holding the ship means holding it on someone else's release. If you read that trade differently, drag the card into "Blocks the ship" and I will plan around it.
